description: Show or hide the core, cavity, and side-action colours on the active part, in the part local frame. on true classifies every face from the mold-analysis pull by complete visibility (core along +pull, cavity along -pull) and paints a true undercut as a side action. A wall within 0.5° of vertical is still core or cavity: it takes the role of the labelled neighbour it can reach, so an inner pocket wall joins the core and an outer wall joins the cavity. There is no separate zero-draft colour. The outer parting loop is a polyline. Stamped faces keep their edge names on that loop. sideActions lists each block: a slide, a lifter, or an unresolved undercut. A block is one piece of steel that forms a connected set of trapped faces and withdraws along one direction. Every trapped feature that shares a direction on one connected surface is one block, whatever the gap between the features, so two holes on one wall are one slide. Each block carries pull (its withdraw direction, never the main pull axis), area (the block face it forms, which includes untrapped surface inside its window), trappedArea, window, span along the main pull, features (the stamped blocks it carries) and frees (the stamped faces it forms). A slide withdraws in the parting plane. A lifter withdraws tilted 15° to 25° into the core, and only when that tilt leaves the part without entering material. An unresolved undercut has no straight direction that frees it (a slot whose ends narrow toward the outer face); it needs a modelling change or a special mechanism. count is every block, slides, lifters and unresolved undercuts, and is what the report prices. group highlights one block. on false removes the skin so face paint and the part colour show again. Omit on to toggle. Read-only. Not a CAD draft edit and not a quote. Molding rules: guide { topic: "molding" }. Long runs: an analysis still going after about 30 s answers { status: "running", stillRunning: true, jobId, command, phase?, percent?, elapsedSec, etaSec? } instead of the result. That is a heartbeat, not the result. Call mold_status { job_id } (it waits up to about 30 s each time) until it answers the result; the analysis keeps running in the tab and is not restarted.

group.description: Side-action group id to highlight. The same id again, or null, clears the highlight. Omit to leave the selection.

on.description: true shows core, cavity, and side-action colours and the outer parting line. false restores paint and the part colour. Omit to toggle.
